en: A black‑and‑white vintage postcard showing the interior of a limestone cave filled with stalactites and stalagmites. The rocky formations dominate the scene, with a relatively flat floor area in the foreground and tall columns and dripping formations rising behind. Printed French text at the bottom identifies the location as caves near Tlemcen and notes the view as the interior of the Grottes d'Aïn‑Fezza.
